ui.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the text and copy it manually.

members.title: Members
members.description: People who can sign in to the team inbox.

empty.noMatchBody: Try a different name, username or role.
empty.noneBody: Add a member so they can sign in.

form.tempPasswordHint: They will be asked to change it at first sign-in.
form.tempPasswordManualHint: Automatic generation is unavailable in this browser. Enter a strong password; they will change it at first sign-in.
form.usernameTooShort: Username must be at least 3 characters.
form.passTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
form.ownRoleHint: You can't change your own role.

create.title: Add member
create.done: {{name}} was added. Share the temporary password with them.

disable.enableBody: They will be able to sign in again.
disable.disableBody: Disabled members are signed out immediately and cannot sign in.

reset.title: Reset password for {{name}}?
reset.body: A new temporary password will be generated and all of their sessions signed out.
reset.newBody: Share this password with {{name}}. It is shown only once; they must change it at next sign-in. Their other sessions were signed out.

revoke.title: Sign {{name}} out everywhere?
revoke.body: All of their devices will be signed out immediately.

quickReplies.title: Quick replies
quickReplies.description: Agents type <kbd>/</kbd> followed by a shortcut in the composer to insert a reply.

empty.noMatchBody: Try a different shortcut or phrase.
empty.noneBody: Create one to speed up common answers.

delete.title: Delete /{{shortcut}}?
delete.body: This quick reply will no longer be available to agents.

form.shortcutHint: Typed after / in the composer, e.g. /{{example}}

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Sign-ins, member changes, WhatsApp and tunnel actions.

actions.userRevokeSessions: Member signed out of all devices

settings.title: Settings
settings.historyInvalid: History must be between 0 and 365 days.
settings.restartBody: Network changes take effect after the app (or service) restarts.

network.title: Network
network.lan: Allow access from the local network (LAN)
network.lanHint: Other devices on the same Wi-Fi can open the inbox.
network.lanWarningBody: Passwords and messages travel unencrypted on your local network. Only enable this on a network you trust; use the tunnel for encrypted remote access.

history.title: History
history.days: Days of history to import when linking

device.title: This device
device.description: Preferences are saved on this device and apply immediately.
device.themeHint: System follows your device's light or dark setting.
device.notificationsHint: Get a notification for new messages when the inbox isn't open.

resolveAll.title: Inbox
resolveAll.description: Finish the day by resolving every open chat for the whole team. Messages are kept and new incoming messages reopen chats automatically.
resolveAll.confirmBody: This will resolve all currently open chats across the whole team. Assignees will be cleared. Messages and unread counts are kept. You can reopen individual chats later.
resolveAll.confirmBodyWithCount: This will resolve all currently open chats across the whole team ({{openCount}} right now). Assignees will be cleared. Messages and unread counts are kept. You can reopen individual chats later.

whatsapp.description: The WhatsApp number linked to this team inbox.
whatsapp.name: Name
whatsapp.replacedBody: This number was connected from another place. Use “Take over” to reconnect here.
whatsapp.scanHint: On the phone: WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device.
whatsapp.waitingQrBody: A code appears here in a few seconds.
whatsapp.phoneTitle: Or link with a phone number
whatsapp.phoneHint: Get an 8-character code instead of scanning the QR.
whatsapp.linkBody: Re-link to show a new QR code, then scan it from the phone.
whatsapp.actionsHint: Log out disconnects this inbox. Re-link starts a fresh pairing. Take over reconnects a session opened elsewhere.

logout.label: Log out
logout.title: Log out of WhatsApp?
logout.body: The linked device is removed from the phone. The team inbox stops receiving and sending messages until you link again. Message history is kept.

relink.label: Re-link
relink.title: Re-link WhatsApp?
relink.body: The current session is discarded and a new QR code is shown. Scan it from WhatsApp > Linked devices on the phone.
relink.done: Session reset — scan the new QR code.

takeover.label: Take over
takeover.title: Take over the session?
takeover.body: Another instance (e.g. WhatsApp Web on another computer) replaced this connection. Taking over reconnects here and disconnects the other one.

tunnel.title: Cloudflare access
tunnel.description: Give your team a link to open the inbox from phones anywhere.

modes.offHint: Only this computer (and the LAN, if enabled).
modes.quickHint: A free link that changes on restart. No account needed.
modes.namedHint: Sign in to Cloudflare and choose a permanent inbox address.

tunnel.tokenRequired: Paste the tunnel token from the Cloudflare dashboard.
tunnel.scanHint: Scan with a phone camera to open the inbox.
tunnel.quickNote: Temporary links change every time the connection or the app restarts. Choose Your domain for a permanent inbox address.
tunnel.advancedTokenBody: For an existing tunnel configured in the Cloudflare dashboard. Guided sign-in above handles this setup for you.
tunnel.tokenHint: Cloudflare Zero Trust → Networks → Tunnels → your tunnel → install token.
tunnel.hostnameHint: The hostname routed to http://127.0.0.1:<port> in the tunnel config.
tunnel.disconnectNote: Disconnect Cloudflare stops the public link. The inbox still works on this computer. Messages and the saved domain are kept, so you can connect again later.
tunnel.disconnectNoteLan: Disconnect Cloudflare stops the public link. The inbox still works on this computer and over your enabled local network. Messages and the saved domain are kept, so you can connect again later.

cloudflare.invalidApproval: The Cloudflare sign-in address could not be verified. Cancel sign-in and try again.

saved.label: Your saved Cloudflare address
saved.runningBody: Your team can use this address and sign in with their inbox accounts.
saved.startingBody: Waiting for Cloudflare to connect. Keep this computer and the app running.
saved.idleBody: Connect the saved address below to make the inbox available to your team.

step1.title: 1. Connect your Cloudflare account
step1.body: Sign in on Cloudflare and approve the domain you want to use. Return here after approval. You need a domain already added to your Cloudflare account.
step1.anotherHint: Only approved domains appear below. Choose another domain starts a new Cloudflare approval.
step1.waitingApproval: Waiting for your approval on Cloudflare…
step1.autoUpdate: This page updates automatically after approval. Keep the app running.

cloudflare.noDomainBody: Add a domain to Cloudflare, then choose another domain to approve it. If you just approved a domain, try Refresh domains.
cloudflare.formInvalid: Check the domain, address and tunnel name.

step2.title: 2. Choose your inbox address
step2.prefixHint: A short word before your domain, such as inbox or support.
step2.tunnelNameHint: A friendly name in Cloudflare so you can recognise this app. It does not change the address.

step3.body: This publishes the inbox using the address above and sets up its Cloudflare connection. Team members still need their normal inbox sign-in. Keep this computer and the app running.
step3.unchanged: This address and tunnel name are already saved.

ai.settingsDescription: Connect ChatGPT or an OpenAI API key. One provider and model is shared by every AI member in this inbox.
ai.membersDescription: Your team and AI assistant for customer chats.
ai.connectionDescription: One provider and model configuration is shared by the entire inbox.
ai.memberDescription: One AI member can help your team answer basic business questions.
ai.behavior: Replies after 10 seconds in unassigned customer chats and takes ownership. Assign the chat to yourself to take over. The AI resolves a chat only after customer confirmation. When it needs help, it assigns an online human with no open chats, or returns the chat to unassigned.
ai.roleDescription: Role: Sales Agent — answers basic questions using your business knowledge.
ai.enableHint: Save to apply. Disabling stops automatic replies.
ai.keyMissing: OpenAI API key is not configured.
ai.keepKeyHint: A key is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a replacement.
ai.apiKeyHint: Stored securely on the inbox server. API usage is billed separately from ChatGPT.
ai.loginHint: Sign in through the supported Codex integration. Open the sign-in link in a browser on the computer running the inbox server so the local callback can complete.
ai.saveModeFirst: Save the ChatGPT connection mode before signing in.
ai.invalidLink: The sign-in link is invalid. Cancel sign-in and try again.
ai.instructionsHint: Describe tone, language and the questions the AI should handle.
ai.notesHint: Add business hours, services, policies and other approved facts.
ai.uploadHint: TXT, Markdown, PDF or DOCX. Up to 20 files, 10 MB per file; scanned PDFs need selectable text. Save the member first. Documents are available to the AI immediately.
ai.fileTypeError: Choose a TXT, Markdown, PDF or DOCX document.
ai.fileSizeError: Documents must be 10 MB or smaller.
ai.modelInvalid: ChatGPT mode supports {{models}}. Leave blank to use the default.
ai.question: Question {{number}}
